prompt.text: Complete this bounded research task with exactly two parent branches: compare JSON and YAML for a human-edited configuration file. Call research_plan_start first with one JSON branch and one YAML branch, allocate one search and one read to each, and immediately dispatch one research-planner child for each returned context. After both reports are terminal, reread each source lead with web_read, record parent-validated evidence cards, and call plan_settle. Do not search or read before planning, delegate again, or broaden the question. Give one cited property and one limitation for each format, then a conditional recommendation; mark any unverified claim as deferred.

negative_control.text: What are the two JSON structural types? Give a short answer from one official source.
